ideas.pitch: A lightweight eye-gaze and head-pose tracking interface built with webcams to allow developers with motor disabilities to navigate and edit code hands-free.
ideas.problem_statement: Human-Machine Interfaces (HMI): Build intuitive, adaptive, and accessible ways for people to interact with computers and intelligent systems beyond traditional keyboards, mice, and touchscreens.
ideas.title: GazeScroll: Accessible Hands-Free Code Navigation
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses accessibility which resonates heavily with academic judges, and utilizes a robust local computer vision pipeline similar to winning pose-estimation architectures.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized service discovery and automated micro-settlement network where idle local AI agents negotiate and trade vector database queries over lightweight HTTP endpoints.
ideas.problem_statement: Autonomous Economy: Create systems, coordination mechanisms, or applications where autonomous AI agents, machines, and digital entities can discover services, negotiate terms, allocate resources, and carry out automated transactions.
ideas.title: AgentMarket: Autonomous Micro-Compute Broker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on genuine multi-agent orchestration and machine-to-machine coordination without relying on standard blockchain buzzwords, matching complex multi-agent system patterns.

ideas.pitch: An automated local log parser that ingests raw firewall and access logs from small clinic routers, translating complex alerts into clear, receptionist-friendly action items.
ideas.problem_statement: Accessible Cybersecurity: Build an automated, intuitive security solution that gives small, non-technical organizations the threat visibility and decision-making clarity of a dedicated security operations team.
ideas.title: ClinicShield: Plain-English Security Operations Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a relatable, highly practical SMB problem and strips away technical jargon, appealing directly to judges looking for real-world utility.

ideas.pitch: A web dashboard that lets developers compile, flash, and debug ESP32 microcontrollers connected to a central lab machine over a secure WebSocket bridge with live serial telemetry.
ideas.problem_statement: Hardware & Embedded Innovation: Build platforms and collaborative tools that enable developers, students, and engineers to remotely access, program, execute, monitor, and debug code on embedded devices.
ideas.title: CloudPi: Remote Browser-Based ESP32 Flashing Pipeline
ideas.why_it_could_win: Involves an unusual physical build and hardware integration which always stands out in a room full of standard web applications.

ideas.pitch: An edge-computing prototype that monitors simulated medical sensor streams on an ESP32, running local anomaly detection and forwarding encrypted alerts to a cloud dashboard.
ideas.problem_statement: Hardware & Embedded Innovation: Build platforms and collaborative tools that enable developers, students, and engineers to remotely access, program, execute, monitor, and debug code on embedded devices.
ideas.title: BioEdge: Post-Operative IoT Telemetry & Anomaly Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the winning formula of combining embedded hardware with edge-based anomaly detection and a slick live-working demo.
